hotel.name: The Meridian House
hotel.description: A contemporary city hotel designed for business and leisure stays.

amenities.swimming_pool: Yes, an outdoor swimming pool is available.
amenities.gym: Yes, the fitness centre is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
amenities.wifi: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.
amenities.parking: Complimentary on-site parking is available for hotel guests.

dining.breakfast: Breakfast is included with the Executive and Family packages. For other room rates, breakfast can be added separately.

policies.cancellation: Reservations can be cancelled without charge up to 24 hours before check-in. Later cancellations may be charged for one night.
policies.children: Children are welcome. Maximum occupancy depends on the selected room.

rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room with one king bed, work desk, and city view.

rooms.name: Executive Room
rooms.description: Business-friendly room with a king bed, workspace, and executive benefits.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite suitable for families or small groups, with a king bed and sofa bed.
